title: Some results about spaceability in function spaces
summary: We investigate two problems concerning spaceability in function spaces. First, we study the spaceability of sets of nowhere regular periodic functions, for various notions of regularity, including Hölder regularity and real analyticity. Second, we show that the set of real analytic functions is spaceable in $C((0,1))$. Moreover, we provide a complete characterization of the closed subspaces of $C((0,1))$ consisting of real analytic functions. Our work solves several open questions posed by Bernal-González et al. [4, 5, 6].
